sources.title: GitHub - usafhulk/Waste-Classifier-AI-model
sources.snippet: Waste Classifier AI Model Overview This project provides an end-to-end solution for automatic waste classification using deep learning and transfer learning techniques. The model is designed to differentiate between recyclable and organic (compostable) waste images, addressing the need for scalable, accurate, and automated waste sorting.
